name: Frost Thrall
rules: Summon Frost Thrall: 16 HP / 6 Power. Attacks apply 1 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
definitionRules: Summon a 16 HP / 6 Power Thrall. Attacks apply 1 Chill.

name: Shattered Queen
rules: Summon Shattered Queen: 12 HP / 3 Power. Attacks hit ALL enemies and apply 1 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
definitionRules: Summon a 12 HP / 3 Power Thrall. Attacks hit ALL enemies and apply 1 Chill.

name: Rime Seer
rules: Summon Rime Seer: 10 HP / 4 Power. Attacks apply 3 Chill. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
definitionRules: Summon a 10 HP / 4 Power Thrall. Attacks apply 3 Chill.

name: Rune Revenant
rules: Summon Rune Revenant: 14 HP / 3 Power. Attacks strike twice. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
definitionRules: Summon a 14 HP / 3 Power Thrall. Attacks strike twice.

name: Bone Defender
rules: Summon Bone Defender: 18 HP / 3 Power. Defender. Rot starts at 1. Automatically spend Corpses equal to its Mana cost instead if available.
definitionRules: Summon an 18 HP / 3 Power Thrall with Defender.

name: Hew
rules: Deal 6 damage.
definitionRules: Deal 6 damage.

name: Brace
rules: Gain 5 Guard.
definitionRules: Gain 5 Guard.

name: Frostbite
rules: Heavy. Deal 8 damage. Apply 3 Chill.
definitionRules: Heavy. Deal 8 damage. Apply 3 Chill.

name: Rimecleave
rules: Deal 5 damage and apply 1 Chill to ALL enemies.
definitionRules: Deal 5 damage and apply 1 Chill to ALL enemies.

name: Glacial Ward
rules: Gain 8 Guard. Draw 1 card.
definitionRules: Gain 8 Guard. Draw 1 card.

name: Frozen Grasp
rules: Apply 3 Chill.
definitionRules: Apply 3 Chill.

name: Command the Dead
rules: All Thralls attack now. Rot triggers.
definitionRules: All Thralls attack now. Their Rot also triggers.

name: Bone Ward
rules: Gain 4 Guard for each Thrall (minimum 4).
definitionRules: Gain 4 Guard for each Thrall you control (minimum 4).

name: Hoarfrost Edge
rules: Deal 4 damage twice. Each hit applies 1 Chill.
definitionRules: Deal 4 damage twice. Each hit applies 1 Chill.

name: Unholy Vigor
rules: Your Thralls gain +2 Power, including future summons.
definitionRules: Your Thralls gain +2 Power, including future summons.

name: Frost Nova
rules: Apply 4 Chill to ALL enemies. Gain 6 Guard.
definitionRules: Apply 4 Chill to ALL enemies. Gain 6 Guard.

name: Soulfrost Blade
rules: Deal 6 damage plus 2 for each Chill on the enemy.
definitionRules: Deal 6 damage plus 2 for each Chill on the enemy.

name: Dark Tithe
rules: Sacrifice a Thrall. Gain 2 Mana. Draw 1 card(s).
definitionRules: Sacrifice a Thrall. Gain 2 Mana. Draw 1 card.

name: Rally the Fallen
rules: All Thralls heal 6 HP and reset Rot to 0.
definitionRules: All Thralls heal 6 HP and reset Rot to 0.

name: Sweeping Hew
rules: Heavy. Deal 10 damage to ALL enemies.
definitionRules: Heavy. Deal 10 damage to ALL enemies.

name: Permafrost Aura
rules: At the start of your turn, apply 2 Chill to ALL enemies.
definitionRules: At the start of your turn, apply 2 Chill to ALL enemies.

name: Glacier Wall
rules: Gain 30 Guard. Consume.
definitionRules: Gain 30 Guard. Consume.
